sources.summary: This zany time-travelling show is a bit like Doctor Who: The Sitcom. Plus, Martin and Roman Kemp take an Irish road trip. Here’s what to watch this evening 10.10pm, Sky Comedy A zany sci-fi comedy that is a bit like Doctor Who: The Sitcom. Warren has a mysterious glittering portal in his shed, but he only ever uses it to dump leaves in. When his teenage daughter is sucked into it one day – leaving her trusty vape behind – he jumps in after her. They find themselves in 2043, where evil refrigerators are trying to kill them (yes, refrigerators). From there, they end up in lots of trouble across different dimensions.
